title: Profile completion
inputSource: Validated saved LearnerProfileV1

requiredStateAndSample: Loaded valid profile; valid enum/range/nonblank checks per field
missingAndSkippedBehavior: No profile=EMPTY/null; save failure=TEMP_UNAVAILABLE/null; diagnostic skip irrelevant
confidenceAndLimitations: Administrative completeness only; optional band/date excluded; field list needs owner approval
privacy: No email/name in analytics; own subject only
observedPrototypeSource: src/features/Onboarding.tsx; src/state.ts; completion metric not implemented

title: Saved track and target
inputSource: Saved validated profile fields
exactCalculation: Display track and nullable targetBand exactly; no proficiency conversion
requiredStateAndSample: Loaded profile; target null or allowed half-band; UNDECIDED valid
missingAndSkippedBehavior: No goal=EMPTY/null; skipped still shows saved goal
confidenceAndLimitations: Goal is self-declared intent, not predicted performance

title: Diagnostic participation state

requiredStateAndSample: Loaded record; NOT_STARTED distinct from SKIPPED_OR_DEFERRED and SUBMITTED
missingAndSkippedBehavior: Never convert skipped to failed or zero; failure=TEMP_UNAVAILABLE, preserve last state as stale
confidenceAndLimitations: Submitted alone does not establish valid scoring
privacy: No response text in state analytics
observedPrototypeSource: src/types.ts; src/features/Diagnostic.tsx

title: Diagnostic answered count
inputSource: Pinned served item IDs and saved typed responses
exactCalculation: count distinct assigned items with a structurally valid nonblank response; denominator=served item count; fallback speech not counted as learner content
requiredStateAndSample: Owned assignment/version loaded; one effective response per item
missingAndSkippedBehavior: No assignment=EMPTY/null, not 0/N; genuine empty new assigned draft=0/N; skipped with draft keeps count
confidenceAndLimitations: Count is not score; writing count not a quality grade; validate speech capture kind
privacy: Answer bodies remain private; expose counts only
observedPrototypeSource: src/data.ts; src/features/Diagnostic.tsx lacks immutable item set

title: Productive response capture status
inputSource: Typed saved written response and speech capture metadata
exactCalculation: Writing=provided iff nonblank text; wordCount=trim/split whitespace count; Speaking=provided only RECORDED with valid session/owned media evidence; NO_MIC_FALLBACK=not provided; score=null
requiredStateAndSample: Loaded pinned attempt; explicit captureKind; duration >=0 finite; never infer recorded from duration alone
missingAndSkippedBehavior: No data=EMPTY/null; skipped preserves existing capture status; legacy fallback-ambiguous=UNSUPPORTED/null
confidenceAndLimitations: Presence/length/duration are not quality or proficiency; no persistence audio claim without stored media
privacy: No audio/text in event payload; explicit media-retention/consent decision
observedPrototypeSource: src/components/MediaControls.tsx; diagnostic wrapper currently loses fallback provenance

title: Completed learning activity count
inputSource: Durable deduplicated owned qualifying completion/submission events
exactCalculation: count unique (learnerId,eventType,referenceId) where LEARNER_ENTERED, valid timestamp <= now, not diagnostic-only, and successful lesson completion or learner-content-bearing activity submission
requiredStateAndSample: Successful event-store load with known historyCompleteSince; current completed checks/events only
missingAndSkippedBehavior: Skipped may have real lesson activity; no records in known tracked period=0; unknown/error coverage=null
confidenceAndLimitations: Counts tracked actions, not learning gains; empty submissions and fixture seeds excluded
privacy: No answer content/PII in analytics; local subject scope explicit

title: Weekly active learning days
inputSource: Same eligible event set as M08; accepted learner IANA timezone
exactCalculation: size(unique localDate(event.occurredAt,timeZone) in Monday 00:00 inclusive to next Monday exclusive, and event <= now))
requiredStateAndSample: Loaded complete tracked period; valid timezone and timestamps
missingAndSkippedBehavior: Known tracked week with no events=0; unknown earlier week coverage=null with reason; diagnostic skip does not gate real events
confidenceAndLimitations: No claim of historic activity before capture starts; DST/calendar tested
privacy: UTC event time, private timezone; no precise location capture
observedPrototypeSource: src/services/platform.ts summarizeGamification uses device timezone currently

title: Today completed activities
inputSource: Eligible M08 events and accepted learner timezone
exactCalculation: count unique eligible events whose localDate equals localDate(now,timeZone); no fixed goal of 4 without approved goal policy
requiredStateAndSample: Known tracked current day; all event writes durable/deduplicated
missingAndSkippedBehavior: Known day empty=0; provider/capture coverage unknown=null; skipped still available
confidenceAndLimitations: Different actions count once; navigation/playback clicks do not qualify
privacy: No behavioral tracking beyond approved completion events
observedPrototypeSource: src/components/ProgressMotivation.tsx currently hard-codes todayGoal=4

title: Current activity streak
inputSource: Distinct eligible active local dates from M08
exactCalculation: If today active, count consecutive active dates backwards from today; else if yesterday active, count backwards from yesterday; else 0; do not cross unknown capture boundary
requiredStateAndSample: Complete known date coverage from historyCompleteSince through now
missingAndSkippedBehavior: Known no-event history=0; unknown coverage=null; skip itself does not break/create streak
confidenceAndLimitations: Activity habit metric only; not IELTS proficiency; timezone changes recompute without rewriting UTC events
privacy: Private event dates; no external telemetry
observedPrototypeSource: src/services/platform.ts summarizeGamification; best streak exists but not mandatory proposed baseline

title: Comparable skill trend
inputSource: At least two independent valid, comparable submitted skill results

missingAndSkippedBehavior: Single attempt, mixed versions or unvalidated source=UNSUPPORTED/null; no fabricated chart line
confidenceAndLimitations: Practice/retest effects mean raw change is not proficiency growth
privacy: Owned comparable source IDs only
